author: current Codex assistant
reasoning: Let k=n/2. Losing positions are exactly those where the minimum pile size occurs more than k times. From such a nonterminal position every move must touch a minimum pile; the new smaller minimum can occur only among the k changed piles, so the result is winning. From any other position, at least k piles exceed the minimum; reduce exactly k of them to that minimum, creating a losing position. When the minimum is zero and occurs more than k times, fewer than k nonempty piles remain and no move exists. This proves the criterion by induction on the total stones.
